facts.fact: SERVIR West Africa and the University of Florida report that GMet successfully tested initial operational capability of CRAFT for district-level maize yield hindcasts in Ghana, linking earth-observation crop type maps to production forecasts, with operationalising the service listed as a next step.

GHA.note: Forecasts use seasonal climate predictors; no satellite reception or use by the weather service is stated.
Project poster on yield forecasting; no digital policy research stated.
